what_differs: The 2026-09-15 sync decided that, because help text does not show in the Dynamic Highlights Panel, field purpose will be explained in record-page documentation and training. Internal syncs also decided a living user-facing training manual. Jira has no ticket for the training manual or record-page documentation, so this content has no owner, scope or due point before go-live.
